scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,green "npm run dev --workspace=@chat/server" "npm run dev --workspace=@chat/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@chat/shared && npm run build --workspace=@chat/server && npm run build --workspace=@chat/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@chat/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@chat/server && npm run typecheck --workspace=@chat/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=@chat/server && npm run test --workspace=@chat/web
